# 社区与商业授权 / Community and commercial authorization

社区源码发行的使用政策，配套源码的使用条件以随附 LICENSE 为准。本页不是独立的软件许可证，不改变既有版本的许可。

Usage policy for the community source distribution. Use of the supplied source follows its accompanying LICENSE. This page is not a standalone software license, does not change licenses of existing releases. This is a source-available model, not a claim of OSI approval.

## 社区免费范围 / Free community scope

同一组织内部自用，最多 20 个已启用的自然人账号，并保留神念界面品牌、LOGO 和版权展示。可在许可范围内修改代码。

Internal use by one organization with up to 20 enabled human accounts, retaining Shennian branding, logo, and copyright displays. Code may be modified within the license terms.

## 人数口径 / Account counting

不是公司全部同事数；Agent、机器人和停用账号不计。同一自然人多个设备不重复计数，同一组织多个部署合并计算，不通过拆分实例规避免费上限。

Count enabled human users of this system, not all company colleagues. Exclude agents, bots, and disabled accounts. Deduplicate devices for the same person and aggregate deployments of the same organization; splitting instances does not multiply the allowance.

## 企业内部商业授权 / Commercial authorization for internal use

超过 20 人，或需要移除、替换、隐藏神念界面品牌、LOGO 或版权展示，任一条件成立即需商业授权。按组织、按年度协商，授权范围、人数、期限和去品牌权益以书面约定为准，不按账号逐个购买。

Commercial authorization is required if usage exceeds 20 people OR if Shennian interface branding, logo, or copyright displays are removed, replaced, or hidden. Authorization is negotiated annually per organization; organization scope, user limits, term, and white-label rights are agreed in writing, not purchased seat by seat.

## 托管与转售 / Hosting and resale

向第三方提供商业托管、多客户服务、白标或转售需单独协商授权，不包含在普通企业内部使用授权内。

Commercial hosting for third parties, multi-customer services, white-label distribution, and resale require separately negotiated authorization, outside ordinary internal-use authorization.

## 署名与第三方许可 / Attribution and third-party licenses

去品牌授权仅限书面约定的神念界面展示，不允许一并删除第三方许可证、依赖署名或依法及依约应保留的源码版权声明。

White-label rights cover only the agreed Shennian interface displays, not removal of third-party licenses, dependency attribution, or source copyright notices required by law or applicable terms.

## 询价与交付 / Quotes and fulfillment

国内企业通过企业微信咨询报价。本许可不附带部署、迁移、培训、定制或响应时间等技术服务承诺；不公开固定价格，不承诺终身更新或无限服务。

Organizations in China can request a quote through WeCom. This license includes no technical-service commitment for deployment, migration, training, customization, or response times. No fixed public price, lifetime updates, or unlimited services are promised.

## 凭证，不是技术锁 / Proof of authorization, not a technical lock

购买后提供组织授权凭证，记录主体、编号、期限、范围及去品牌权益。不要求激活码、在线授权校验或向官方回传企业成员数据，不因授权到期自动锁机或删除数据。无技术锁不代表商业使用权永久有效，到期需续费或调整到免费许可范围。

Purchasers receive proof identifying the organization, reference number, term, scope, and white-label rights. No activation key, online licensing check, or member-data reporting is required, and expiry does not automatically lock the system or delete data. Lack of a technical lock does not make commercial rights perpetual; renew or return to the free permitted scope when the term ends.

## 移动端与海外 / Mobile and international use

手机 App 只负责连接和使用，不通过 iOS 内购销售企业 Server 授权。公共代码保持同一套，提供中英文说明；海外商业咨询先人工评估，暂不提供自动收款或全球交付承诺。海外商务邮件渠道确认前，请使用官网联系入口。

The mobile app connects and operates the system; enterprise Server authorization is not sold through iOS in-app purchases. The same public code serves all regions with Chinese and English documentation. International commercial requests are assessed manually, without automated checkout or a global delivery commitment. Until a business email is confirmed, use the website contact entry.
